2609.11274.title: Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 Technical Report
2609.11274.paper_summary: Recently, large language model (LLM) based ASR models have achieved significant progress, yet they generally lack support for multi-speaker scenarios, where the cocktail party problem remains a critical bottleneck for further advancing ASR. Existing TS-ASR methods, including end-to-end architectures with speaker embeddings and latest LLM-based explorations suffer from degraded single-speaker performance and the inability to reject when the target speaker is absent. In this paper, we propose Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1, an LLM-based end-to-end TS-ASR architecture. By utilizing reference speech as voiceprint prompts, it directly transcribes the target speaker's speech without requiring speech separation. Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 maintains competitive performance in single-speaker scenarios, comparable to mainstream ASR models. It also features a negative sample rejection capability, outputting empty text when the target speaker is absent from the mixed speech. Additionally, Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 supports a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning mode to provide explicit reasoning steps. Extensive experiments on various synthetic and real-world multispeaker benchmarks demonstrate that Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively addressing the cocktail party problem through a unified architecture that balances multispeaker and single-speaker recognition accuracy, along with rejection capability.
2609.11274.paper_summary_zh: 最近，基於大型語言模型（LLM）的自動語音識別（ASR）模型已取得顯著進展，但它們通常缺乏對多說話者場景的支持，其中雞尾酒會問題仍然是進一步推進ASR的關鍵瓶頸。現有的時間序列自動語音識別（TS-ASR）方法，包括帶有說話者嵌入的端到端架構和最新的基於LLM的探索，均面臨單說話者性能下降及在目標說話者缺席時無法拒絕的問題。本文提出了Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1，一種基於LLM的端到端TS-ASR架構。通過利用參考語音作為聲紋提示，它直接轉錄目標說話者的語音，而無需語音分離。Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1在單說話者場景中保持競爭力的性能，與主流ASR模型相當。它還具備負樣本拒絕能力，當目標說話者在混合語音中缺席時輸出空文本。此外，Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1支持鏈式思考（CoT）推理模式，以提供明確的推理步驟。在各種合成和真實世界的多說話者基準上進行的廣泛實驗表明，Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1實現了最先進的性能，有效地通過統一架構解決了雞尾酒會問題，平衡了多說話者和單說話者的識別準確性以及拒絕能力。
